    • ajouterMatch

      public int ajouterMatch(int equipeDomicile, int equipeExterieur, int championnatId, int stadeId, int arbitreId, String dateMatch, int scoreDomicile, int scoreExterieur, String statut)
      Adds a match to the database.
      Parameters:
      equipeDomicile - the ID of the home team
      equipeExterieur - the ID of the away team
      championnatId - the championship ID
      stadeId - the stadium ID
      arbitreId - the referee ID
      dateMatch - the date of the match
      scoreDomicile - the home team's score
      scoreExterieur - the away team's score
      statut - the status of the match
      Returns:
      the number of rows affected (typically 1 if successful)
